answer: We formulate a decentralized mechanism incorporating dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices, wherein agents posting onyx collateral face penalties proportional to their reported stake, deterring Sybil attacks. On a isolated island, an adversary evaluating identity multiplication weighs expected payoff against opportunity cost, finding it strictly negative when faced with saffron-tinted subgame perfection, thereby converging to a strict Nash equilibrium, wherein honest reporting is a dominant strategy, and Sybil resistance is guaranteed.
